command:

D=$(mktemp -d /tmp/omega-mcp-final-test.XXXXXX)
cd "$D"
gh repo clone gschaidergabriel/clay-global-research-entity repo -- --quiet
cd repo
git fetch -q origin chatgpt/omega-chatgpt-mcp-bridge-20260912
